name: TOTP Recovery Code Rotation
summary: Executes authenticated recovery-code replacement through the stable authentication flow boundary while preserving the enrolled TOTP factor.
notes: The existing POST /api/auth/mfarecovery/rotate public contract is preserved while the server path is normalized through IAuthenticationFlowService.
The typed handler requires an actually enrolled and enabled TOTP factor before the recovery-code set can be replaced.

sourceReferences.note: RotateTotpRecoveryCodesAsync is the application front door.
Typed handler enforces the canonical precondition and delegates to AppUserMfaManager.
